newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria Jan retail sales fall 38.4 pct real yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria Jan retail sales fall 38.4 pct real yr/yr.

text.p: Bulgarian retail sales in the first month of this year were a real 38.4 percent lower than a year earlier, National Statistical Institute (NSI) figures show.
BULGARIA RETAIL SALES JAN JAN-DEC'96 JAN'96
"Sales of goods and services fell because the purchasing power of consumers sharply declined due to the high inflation," NSI spokesman Dimitar Fratev told a news conference.
Sales of foods fell by a real 30.1 percent year-on-year and non-food sales declined by a real 22.5 percent, figures showed.
Preliminary NSI estimates put monthly consumer price inflation at 43.8 percent for the first 25 days of January. It was expected near 100 percent in February.
